def transform(grid):
    # Preserve the colored pattern above the divider, recolor it, and remove
    # pixels in the pattern that correspond to missing cells below it.
    sep = next(r for r, row in enumerate(grid) if len(set(row)) == 1 and row[0] not in (0,))
    top = grid[:sep]
    below = grid[sep+1:]
    color = next(v for row in top for v in row if v != 0)
    holes = {(r, c) for r, row in enumerate(below) for c, v in enumerate(row) if v == 0}
    out = []
    for r, row in enumerate(top):
        out.append([2 if v == color and (r, c) not in holes else 0 for c, v in enumerate(row)])
    return out
